types.name: Application
docs: A registered application (D63), with the challenge period of each kind
of claim, set once (D17).

types.name: Challenge
docs: An open challenge of a proof (D49, D81). A job can have several (D88).

fields.name: deposit
docs: D81, D91: the commitment fee, times the number of the question.

fields.name: asked
docs: Parent only: the block whose parent is asked for.

fields.name: operator_work
docs: Fork only: the most mining work shown on each side, counted from the
block where the branches part. 256-bit numbers, big-endian.

types.name: Checkpoint
docs: A block shown on one side of a competing-branch challenge, and the work
of that side up to and with it. Any of them can be built on, so nobody
can freeze a side by showing a block that goes nowhere.

types.name: Config
docs: Set once at initialize. The lowest allowed block number (D93) and the
difficulty limits. A deployment always has the limits of the rules; only
a test build can lower them.

types.name: Credit
docs: Money an address can withdraw.

fields.name: operator_block
docs: A block of the operator's branch, from the anchor to the proof's block.

fields.name: guardian_block
docs: Another block with the same parent.

fields.name: guardian_tip
docs: The best block on top of `guardian_block`.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the fees and receives them back (D62, D65).

fields.name: commitment_fee
docs: The fee at the price of the moment, and what was sent above the fees

fields.name: claim_kind
docs: 0 for a settlement, otherwise the kind of claim, counted from 1.

fields.name: tip
docs: The block on top of the proof that was shown with it.

fields.name: deepest
docs: The oldest block of the operator's branch asked for and shown (D81).

fields.name: parents_shown
docs: How many parents were shown; the next question is this + 1 (D91).

fields.name: attester
docs: D42: who locked x in the operator's place, if anyone.

fields.name: open_challenges
docs: How many challenges of the job are open.

types.name: Note
docs: D47: a guardian's sealed note, and the slot it was sealed in.

types.name: Operator
docs: Everything an operator has locked (D31), and the part locked for jobs.

fields.name: chain_head_txid
docs: D30, D34: the coin its next tagged transaction must spend.

fields.name: proof_block
docs: The block that holds the transaction.

fields.name: tip
docs: A block on top of it, far enough for the confirmations.

fields.name: raw_tx
docs: The transaction, without witness data, and its id.

fields.name: head_index
docs: The input that spends the chain head; the output with the same number
is the next chain head (N23).

fields.name: tag_index
docs: The output that carries the tag.

types.name: Protocol
docs: The single record of the protocol. It holds no key: nothing can change
after deployment (D59).

types.name: TagRecord
docs: An application uses a tag once (D80).

types.name: UsedTx
docs: A Bitcoin transaction settles one job on this network (D80), and a
transaction used as a chain head can never settle one.
